scope: private supplemental controlled ordered-pair and category-revocation cohorts; not full module/suite, desktop AltGr or physical proof

expected_names: key combinations: a pair id is two catalogue keys in order (key-combinations-2026-10-01)
key combinations: the three former chords are the recommended pairs (key-combinations-2026-10-01)
key combinations: both slots are read per ordered pair, bad values are refused (key-combinations-2026-10-01)
key combinations: the key already down is the first key (key-combinations-2026-10-01)
key combinations: a repeat never starts a pair, and follows the pair that took its press (key-combinations-2026-10-01)
key combinations: the switch off and the wizard leave the keys alone (key-combinations-2026-10-01)
key combinations: AltGr's fake LCtrl is not a first key (key-combinations-2026-10-01)
key combinations: hold 1 + tap 2 runs the tap slot, and repeats it (key-combinations-2026-10-01)
key combinations: hold 1 + hold 2 holds the hold slot (key-combinations-2026-10-01)
key combinations: a pair with both slots is a tap on a quick release, a hold otherwise (key-combinations-2026-10-01)
key combinations: a pair's action runs through the catalogue (key-combinations-2026-10-01)
key combinations: the first key's own tap is cancelled, once (key-combinations-2026-10-01)
key combinations: the slots are written to config.toml and reload the driver (key-combinations-2026-10-01)
key combinations: restoring or clearing Shortcuts removes the undeclared slots (key-combinations-2026-10-01)
key combinations: the menu lists every ordered pair by hand, with its two slots (key-combinations-2026-10-01)
key combinations: every key has its pair hotkeys, created first (key-combinations-2026-10-01)
key combinations: category publication stops retained repeat effects without surrendering the press (pair-category-revocation)
key combinations: published category revocation before Fire permits no new effect (pair-category-revocation)

key combinations: first-key callback revocation prevents a new modifier owner (pair-category-revocation)
key combinations: first-key callback revocation prevents a new layer owner (pair-category-revocation)
key combinations: actual pair-log callback revocation prevents the following tap (pair-category-revocation)
key combinations: modifier retirement rejoins category before its delayed tap (pair-category-revocation)
key combinations: layer retirement rejoins category before its delayed tap (pair-category-revocation)
key combinations: category revocation does not reclassify completed hold retirement (pair-category-revocation)
key combinations: actual single-modifier resolver log rejoins category before owner acquisition (pair-category-revocation)
key combinations: actual multi-modifier resolver log rejoins category before owner acquisition (pair-category-revocation)
key combinations: actual duration fallback log rejoins category before layer acquisition (pair-category-revocation)
